Subject: Cracking above living room window – earlier repair never done

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about a crack above the living room window that is getting worse. I reported this problem about five months ago and someone was supposed to come out, but no repair was ever arranged and nobody came. Since then the crack has widened and now there are smaller cracks branching off it, and the plaster around it is bulging slightly. There is also a fine dust on the windowsill, which makes me worried the plaster is starting to break away and could fall while we are sitting in the room. It also feels damp near the top of the wall. I would really appreciate it if someone could inspect this properly this time.

Thank you,
A concerned tenant

Hi, really sorry to bother you again, I know you're busy. I wanted to let you know the mould in my son's bedroom has got a lot worse over the last couple of days. There's black patches spreading across the wall behind his bed and up near the window, and the whole room smells musty. I've been wiping it down but it keeps coming back. The worrying thing is my son's asthma has really flared up this week - he's using his inhaler a lot more at night and coughing in his sleep. I don't want to make a fuss but he's only six and I'm honestly scared about him sleeping in there. Is there any chance someone could come out really soon please? Thank you so much, and sorry again for chasing.

gold.duration: worsening over the last couple of days

text: Hi, it's the tenant in the upstairs flat, sorry to ring and leave a message, I know you're busy. My mother stays with us at the moment, she's over seventy and has trouble with her balance, and honestly I nearly went over myself this morning. I'm worried someone will fall down those stairs before long. Could someone come out as soon as possible please, and apologies again for the hassle. Thank you.
